# Spec 04 - Interface layer (`emulator/modules/<id>/controllers/`)

**No files yet** (YAGNI). `emulator/controllers/` stays with its `.gitkeep`; `urlManager.rules` stays empty; with strict
parsing every URL answers 404 from Yii.

## What comes later (not generated by Part A - it is Part B of this same skill)
With the first emulated service, its module `emulator/modules/<id>/` (same id as the API module) gets one thin controller
(`emulator/modules/<id>/controllers/`, extending `yii\rest\Controller`) whose actions play the service's endpoints: take the request, convert it into a command of
value objects, call the application service (Part B §B.3.2), return the emulated response. Controllers get the use cases through
the constructor (`__construct($id, $module, <use cases>, $config = [])`); URL rules in the module's `bootstrap()`; the module is registered in `emulator/config/web.php` (`modules`, `bootstrap`) and
its migration namespace in `emulator/config/console.php` (`migrationNamespaces`, history `emulator_migration`). The endpoints
and their bodies come from the module's own specs (`development/<name>/specs/module.service.yaml`, `module.service.md`),
generated by **Part B** of `generate-emulator` (SKILL.md §B.3.4), never into `emulator/controllers/` (this directory, Part A's).

## Checks
- Controllers never import infrastructure (must print nothing): `grep -rn '[\]infrastructure[\]' emulator/controllers emulator/modules/*/controllers 2>/dev/null`
- HTTP smoke test: `http://emulator.dev:81/` answers 404 from Yii, not 500.
